# jumpcloud_password_policy (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud password policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_password_policy" "example" {
  name                             = "Strong Password Policy"
  min_length                       = 12
  max_length                       = 128
  needs_uppercase                  = true
  needs_lowercase                  = true
  needs_numeric                    = true
  needs_symbolic                   = true
  min_changes                      = 4
  password_expiration_in_days      = 90
  lockout_threshold                = 5
  lockout_duration_in_seconds      = 300
  days_before_expiration_to_notify = 14
  precedence                       = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_unenrolled_mfa_password_reset` (Boolean) Whether users not enrolled in MFA can reset their password.
- `allow_username_substring` (Boolean) Whether the password can contain the username.
- `days_after_expiration_to_self_recover` (Number) Days after expiration a user can self-recover. -1 means unlimited.
- `days_before_expiration_to_force_reset` (Number) Days before expiration to force a password reset.
- `description` (String) Description of the password policy.
- `disallow_commonly_used_passwords` (Boolean) Whether commonly used passwords are disallowed.
- `disallow_sequential_or_repetitive_chars` (Boolean) Whether sequential or repetitive characters are disallowed.
- `display_complexity_on_reset_screen` (Boolean) Whether to display password complexity requirements on the reset screen.
- `enable_days_after_expiration_to_self_recover` (Boolean) Whether self-recovery after expiration is enabled.
- `enable_days_before_expiration_to_force_reset` (Boolean) Whether forced reset before expiration is enabled.
- `enable_lockout_time_in_seconds` (Boolean) Whether timed lockout is enabled.
- `enable_max_history` (Boolean) Whether password history enforcement is enabled.
- `enable_max_login_attempts` (Boolean) Whether login attempt limiting is enabled.
- `enable_min_change_period_in_days` (Boolean) Whether minimum change period enforcement is enabled.
- `enable_min_length` (Boolean) Whether minimum length enforcement is enabled.
- `enable_password_expiration_in_days` (Boolean) Whether password expiration is enabled.
- `enable_recovery_email` (Boolean) Whether recovery email is enabled.
- `enable_reset_lockout_counter` (Boolean) Whether lockout counter reset is enabled.
- `lockout_time_in_seconds` (Number) Duration of account lockout in seconds.
- `max_history` (Number) Number of previous passwords to remember.
- `max_login_attempts` (Number) Number of failed attempts before account lockout.
- `min_change_period_in_days` (Number) Minimum days between password changes.
- `min_length` (Number) Minimum password length.
- `name` (String) The name of the password policy.
- `needs_lowercase` (Boolean) Whether the password must contain lowercase characters.
- `needs_numeric` (Boolean) Whether the password must contain numeric characters.
- `needs_symbolic` (Boolean) Whether the password must contain special characters.
- `needs_uppercase` (Boolean) Whether the password must contain uppercase characters.
- `password_expiration_in_days` (Number) Number of days until the password expires.
- `precedence` (Number) Priority when multiple policies apply. Higher values take precedence.
- `reset_lockout_counter_minutes` (Number) Minutes after which the lockout counter resets.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the password policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_password_policy.example <policy-id>
```
